summary.text: Douglas Mangeris, the Libertarian Party nominee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Colorado's 4th District to Democrat Eileen Laubacher, receiving 3.3% of the vote according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He previously appeared on the 2024 Libertarian ballot list for the district before withdrawing.
Little other biographical information is publicly available.

sources.title: Colorado's 4th District U.S. House election results 2026
